stumbles.quote: lock screen rotation in portrait, and pick your options before you turn the phone
stumbles.why: Conflicts with the later statement that the game asks for landscape and you turn the phone. It's unclear how a portrait-locked phone can be turned to landscape, and what 'turn' means when rotation is locked.

stumbles.quote: The game asks for landscape itself and shows a prompt telling you to turn the phone. If rotation is unlocked, the screen will flip on its own.
stumbles.why: It doesn't explain how the game can show landscape while rotation is locked. It also doesn't say whether the screen should flip or stay fixed once you physically turn the phone.

stumbles.quote: This screen is held in portrait.
stumbles.why: Unclear whether this describes the game's behavior or tells me to hold the phone in portrait. 'Held' is ambiguous.

stumbles.quote: Top of the phone away from you
stumbles.why: In landscape the 'top' is ambiguous. It could mean the top edge as held in landscape or the original portrait top, and it's unclear which direction accelerates.

stumbles.quote: The game reads its current tilt as neutral when the start lights go out
stumbles.why: Start lights have never been mentioned or explained. It's unclear when they appear or how long to hold steady.

stumbles.quote: Three tracks ship: Fjord, Quarry and Ring.
stumbles.why: 'Ship' is jargon and the tracks are not described. Laps and difficulty options are also not listed, so I don't know the available values.

point: Lock portrait rotation, choose track, laps and difficulty, tap Start engine, then turn the phone to landscape when prompted and hold it steady to set neutral before tilting to steer, accelerate and brake.
